|translation='''Title:''' Gold 2.

'''Card text:'''
May add up to 2 pilots and passengers in total. May be forfeited in place of another starfighter hit at Death Star: Trench. May not use power, maneuver, or hyperspeed without a pilot.

'''Lore:'''
The Y-wing Tiree flew at the Battle of Yavin. Custom side thrusters improve its handling, so Gold 2 is good at slipping through enemy fire.
